target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, native boot-context compiler
evidence: A #exe block attempted to generate a function declaration with StreamPrint; the guest reported an unresolved StreamPrint external before it could load the later function.
The original fast source probe incorrectly printed SOURCE COMPILES despite that unresolved-call message. The corrected probe reports SOURCE BLOCKED and exits before invoking the requested function.
limits: No StreamPrint implementation is provided by this change. The pinned compiler appends formatted text to the active stream block and feeds it back into the lexer; implementing that behavior needs correct nested-block, lookahead, ownership and exception handling.
This probe does not validate TimeIns, AOT compilation, or physical targets. Historical catalog results have not been re-audited for this particular error class.
